records.raw_text: Active · Jennings completed eight of 11 passes for 91 yards and a touchdown, losing four yards on two carries, in Saturday's 45-34 win at Tulsa. · Jennings was forced into his first collegiate action when quarterback Preston Stone (collarbone) left the game in the second quarter. With Stone now out for the remainder of the season, it appears Jennings will be the signal caller until Tanner Mordecai (concussion) is able to return. The Mustangs ran the ball more often than usual following the quarterback change, but Jennings was solid when called upon. At the very least, Jennings will be a backup for the remainder of the season, and proved he can do the job when he's in the game.
